name: DHC Software Co.,Ltd.
summary: DHC Software Co.,Ltd. provides application software development, computer information system integration, and information technology services for the financial, healthcare, government, water conservancy, public security, and telecommunications sectors in China. The company offers medical products and solutions, such as smart hospital, health, elderly care, and medical insurance, as well as internet healthcare products.
